brief.subtitle: How NOYA runs the Egypt side of a YKONE brief, and what we need from you to propose.
brief.lead: YKONE is looking at the Egypt market. NOYA is a UK-based concierge and destination management company specialising in Egypt. This brief turns our conversation of 8 October into a working method, so the next YKONE brief that points to Egypt can move straight to a proposal.

email.subject: Re: NOYA Concierge × YKONE | Egypt & Beyond
paragraphs: Following our call on 8 October, I have prepared a short Egypt brief for YKONE.

It sets out how we would work together: YKONE brings the vision and the client brief, and NOYA brings the Egypt side to life, on the ground and under your name. It covers the formats we can support, from campaigns and creator trips to private dinners, with one example evening at Giza.

Giza is busy this autumn and the Grand Egyptian Museum marks its first year on 5 November. If anything is planned for this quarter or next, share whatever is known and we will come back with a concept and a costed proposal.
review: Replaces the text of Adam's own 19 Oct edit of the draft (kept in studio_outputs evidence). Same opening and close in his words; the middle now matches the master brief v4. ATTACH APPROVED PDF before sending.

rows: A terrace facing the Pyramids, or an evening at the Grand Egyptian Museum.
Guests collected from their hotels at sunset and met by a NOYA host.
One long table in low light, dressed to YKONE’s creative direction.

Modern Egyptian, served to share; the menu is created with the chef once the venue is set.
